snippet.title: Rat Run Trailer | AVAILABLE NOW!
snippet.description:
Jump your way through endless obstacles and smash incoming enemies as a cheese-thirsty rat! Accelerate to the maximum speed and unlock all biomes and playable rodents!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3713510/Rat_Run/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Rodent.RatRun
